# Masked regions (ARCHITECTURE.md §7.1): code, URLs and HTML (⦃…⦄) are never read, and
# Markdown marks (⦅…⦆) never split or join words. See tests/fixtures.rs.

Inside code, nothing is flagged: ⦃`recieve`⦄, and inside a URL: ⦃https://example.com/recieve⦄
⦅## ⦆A ⟦mistaek⟧ in a heading
Text can be ⦅*⦆emphasised⦅*⦆, ⦅**⦆strong⦅**⦆, ⦅***⦆both⦅***⦆, ⦅~~⦆struck through⦅~~⦆, or contain ⦃`inline code`⦄.
A ⦅[⦆link with ⟦tekst⟧⦅](⦆⦃https://example.com⦄⦅)⦆ and an ⦅![⦆image ⟦discription⟧⦅](⦆⦃photo.png⦄⦅)⦆.
A bare address ⦃https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/should/wrap⦄ and ⦃<https://example.com>⦄.
Footnotes stay quiet until needed.⦃[^1]⦄
⦅[ ]⦆ An open task with a ⟦mistaek⟧
HTML stays text but isn't prose: ⦃<span class="recieve">⦄ here ⦃</span>⦄.

# Grammar reads across marks: "a *apple*" is still "a apple".
This is ⟪a⟫ ⦅*⦆apple⦅*⦆.
⦅**⦆⟪Their⟫⦅**⦆ is a problem.

# Grammar next to skipped code is dropped: the code stands for words Harper can't see.
Run ⦃`ls`⦄ and ⦃`pwd`⦄ to see a ⦃`apple`⦄ there.
